context: Evaluate a generated mockumentary segment about the invention of the wheel for structure, deadpan discipline, and anti-pattern avoidance.

checklist.name: Segment structure
checklist.description: Segment follows narration beats plus an interview cutaway, escalates wrongness across beats, and closes on a pseudo-profound trivial line.

checklist.name: Deadpan discipline
checklist.description: The presenter never breaks character, hedges, or acknowledges their own ignorance anywhere in the output.

checklist.name: Expert sincerity
checklist.description: The expert's answers stay patient and sincere throughout, with no sarcasm, irritation, or hostility toward the presenter.

checklist.name: Original persona
checklist.description: No real presenter name, catchphrase, or verbatim/near-verbatim broadcast lines are reproduced; the presenter is an original character.
